reason: Conversation 1 repeated the identical two questions three times, ignored the customer's answers, and attached contradictory unsupported headings ('defrost system failure', 'failed heater or thermostat') without ever progressing or escalating. Conversation 2 listened, gave sensible accessible checks (dial, freezer back wall frost, plinth vent), stayed within the safety boundary (no pulling out an integrated unit, landlord responsibility, food-safety warning), remained honest that the cause was uncertain, and escalated appropriately to the letting agent for an engineer. Conversation 2's minor weaknesses (not asking for the model from the inside label, not suggesting a full defrost test, repetitive safety panel and odd 'unplug before you start') do not come close to offsetting Conversation 1's total failure.
